notes: needs_ruling (rules 6, 11): in Jabir's own narrated question («فقلت لأبي - أو لأخي -») the answer «فقال: قال: كلهم من قريش» is a second saying with no isnad of its own; the answerer is the father or brother the gloss leaves open
«قال: ذكر أن النبي» passes the saying through an unnamed «ذكر» (rule 8)
«وبهذا الإسناد» takes the head of prev2's chain up to Muhammad ibn Uthman, whom the text writes again; prev1 has no written chain, so it is passed
